title: A new report in Australia has warned that the rapid expansion of data centres could add 39 million tonnes of greenhouse gases within a single decade if these centres rely on fossil fuels. The report focuses on nine proposed centres that are the largest in terms of electricity consumption, and notes that data centres' electricity use over a decade could roughly equal the consumption of all homes in two large states. In response, companies in the sector say they offset 70% of their consumption through renewable energy agreements. Simply put: AI needs a huge amount of electricity, and the question is where that electricity comes from. Should governments require new data centres to use renewable energy? 🌱
